text:
sophia: Heads-up 1: product wants a sharp battlecard and two bench hooks for next demo vs cloud-managed endpoints + API vendors. Keep SDR copy tiny and defensible.

ben: Agreed. SDR asks for 2 subject lines + 3 opens <12 words, and one-line comebacks to 'we already run X'.

karim: Draft opens: 1) \"Want to stop surprise inference bills? 10m?\" 2) \"Need predictable p99s without swapping models?\" 3) \"Want a simple cost model for your workload?\"

ellie: Love those. For comebacks: A) \"Scaling up is expensive; we tune serving to lower unit cost.\" B) \"No rip-and-replace 1 we layer on your models.\" C) \"We provide SLA-backed tail metrics, not just instance sizes.\"

sophia: For bench hooks we need one cost-first and one tail-first claim with method note. Try phrasing differently than other decks.

ben: Cost hook: \"Batch generators saw ~27% lower unit token cost after continuous-run batching + payload quantization.\" Method: 6k mixed traces, peak injection, naive vs continuous-run.

karim: Tail hook: \"Tail-smoothed p99 dropped from ~1.05s to ~340ms using smart routing + prefix cache fallback.\" Method: 4.5k real chat traces, measured p95/p99 across policies.

bench-bot: upload_note: https://drive.redwood/bench/1789999998/samples.csv (auto)

ellie: For SDR playbook, give 3 tested opens and a 1-line objection card for the common vendor reply. Keep reps' copy <10 words where possible.

sophia: Proposed A/B subject lines: A) \"Stop surprise inference bills 1 15min\" B) \"Live p99 tail trace 1 15min demo\". Run 48hr test.

ben: Field script (cost): \"Ask for their monthly token volume, show reserved vs continuous-run forecasts, highlight predictable spend.\" Field script (latency): \"Offer a 60s tail-trace demo and point at fallback policies.\"

karim: Add a single-line battlecard row for \"Operational lift\": \"Cloud: low initial friction, ops grow; Redwood: small setup, predictable ops and cost governance.\" Keep it pithy.

ellie: Webinar hook: open with a two-sentence customer vignette (holiday spike), show two panels (cost over time and p99 waterfall), then demo tail tracer live. CTA: \"Book a 15-min tail review for your app.\"

sophia: Timeline: ben to drop bench narratives by EOD, karim to export slides from CSV by Wed AM, ellie to run 5-rep SDR playtest Thu. Sumit will own analytics conversion.

sumit: Got it. I'll convert the CSV to a two-panel slide: left = unit cost delta by routing (hosted/dedicated/private), right = p99 before/after. ETA Tue noon. Method note attached in slide notes.

bench-bot: reminder: calendar invite sent 1 Webinar narrative sync Fri 11:00am PT.

ben: One more ask 1 let's select one defensible numeric claim for the battlecard (we'll include sample size + CI). Suggest \"~27% unit token cost reduction on batch generators (6k-sample, 95% CI)\". Objections?

karim: Fine. Keep the language conservative and point to methodology.

ellie: I'll run the playtest and capture which open wins and which comeback falls flat. Report back Friday.

sophia: Nice work. If anyone hears competitor lines that claim \"better model breadth\", post them here and we'll craft a neutral serving-first reply. Wrap for now. :sparkles:
